scientific_integrity: The scalar Landweber covariance response and large-versus-small singular-mode issue are present in the cited motivating paper; the claim assessed here is the sharp, rank-uniform comparative constant and its linear-in-iteration asymptotics. Supplementary numerical tests are not a proof and originality remains subject to unindexed equivalent results.
scientific_limitations: White observation noise; exact finite-step Landweber covariance; step with 0<omega ||A||_2^2<=1; exact leading normal-eigenspace truncation rather than a randomized SVD; spectral-norm rank-compression comparison. No statement about estimated eigenvectors, confidence coverage, bias, or residual correction.
title: Sharp rank-agnostic covariance loss from leading-singular-mode Landweber truncation
